text: Every production starts as a project. Choose New project, then Blank project.
Give it a name, and a line on what the production is.
Add a cover, and frame it the way you want it seen.
Pick the production type, then drop in your first stills, briefs or scripts.
Create it, and the project page holds the cover, the story and the production details together.
Everything you upload lands in Files and references, sorted as it arrives.
Tag what each file is for: a reference, a raw file, work in progress, or a final asset.
Final assets show up front, under the description, ready to share.
